trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Keep the other 54 checklist entries accurate and finish the full list. The platinum follows when the remaining trophies are earned; there is no online set in this PS5 launch list.

citations.supports: The platinum condition and the 55-trophy solo list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Progress through the opening campaign until the main mission Gone Fishing is complete. The trophy is listed as an automatic story unlock; no collectible or optional medal is named as a condition.

citations.supports: Automatic unlock from the opening main mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 1 main-story sequence. Keep a manual save before the chapter ends as a general recovery point; the chapter trophy itself is described as an automatic progression unlock.

citations.supports: Automatic chapter transition unlock and save-slot recommendation.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Continue the main campaign through Chapter 2. The guide lists this as automatic story progress, with no separate challenge or medal condition.

citations.supports: Automatic story progression unlock.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3's main missions. The trophy guide reports an automatic chapter-related unlock; keep a separate save if you want a way back to earlier free roam.

citations.supports: Automatic chapter unlock and no-mission-replay save advice.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story sequence. This is a campaign trophy rather than a gold-medal test; the guide describes its unlock as automatic story progression.

citations.supports: Chapter completion trigger and absence of mission medal requirements.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign's final main mission. The cited roadmap says the story can be followed by free-roam cleanup, so finish remaining activities afterward if needed; keep a manual save before the finale if you want to preserve that point.

citations.supports: Final-mission trigger, post-story cleanup and save recommendation.
Manual save before the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Breakfast Run. It is a direct mission unlock in the cited guide, so no extra activity or side objective is listed for this trophy.

citations.supports: Automatic unlock during the named main mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist as part of the campaign. The trophy guide marks it as story-related and automatic; follow the mission marker rather than treating it as a separate robbery checklist.

citations.supports: Automatic unlock during the named main mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the main mission Child's Play. The cited trophy guide lists the unlock as automatic story progress and does not require a particular medal result.

citations.supports: Automatic unlock during the named main mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners main mission when it appears in the campaign. The source reports an automatic mission-related unlock.

citations.supports: Automatic unlock during the named main mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign mission VCIA Takedown. It is listed as an automatic mission trophy, with no separate collectible count or medal requirement.

citations.supports: Automatic unlock during the named main mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory during the campaign. The cited roadmap marks the trophy as an automatic story unlock.

citations.supports: Automatic unlock during the named main mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and use that in-game checklist as the authority. Work completed earlier still counts. The guide lists specific partial collection and activity requirements; it does not ask for every activity or every collectible in the world.

citations.supports: Menu path, post-story availability, carried progress and checklist scope.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Mix the stunt categories that suit you: jumps, flights beneath bridges, knife flights and base jumps all add to the total. Check the trophy counter while working; the 100% checklist has a separate 300-stunt target, so stop at 250 only if this trophy is your last stunt goal.

citations.supports: Four counted stunt categories and the separate 300-stunt checklist target.
100% completion stunt count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one activity in each of the nine types listed in the game's Progress > Activities menu: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Use that menu to spot the type you have not tried yet.

citations.supports: The nine activity types and the menu used to inspect them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit every Shooting Range challenge and earn its gold medal; the cited location guide enumerates the full 42-challenge set. Track the medal count in the trophy list so a missed range or challenge is easy to isolate.

citations.supports: All 42 gold-medal challenges and their locations.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Find each Top Fun location and win at least one drone race there. The location guide lists 14 locations and their races; use the in-game trophy counter to find any location still missing a win.

citations.supports: Fourteen locations and the per-location win condition.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win races with distinct event identities; repeating the same course is not a substitute for 20 different races. The race guide is a location index, and the trophy counter is the safest check that a win counted as new.

citations.supports: Race locations and the unique-race distinction.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take part in Cal's fishing challenge and finish ahead of him. The fishing guide covers the challenge setup and fishing steps; use its Cal section if the activity is not yet available on your map.

citations.supports: Cal's fishing challenge and setup.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose any one of the four reported arcade games, then finish every level in that game. Optional challenges are not needed. The TV games at home and the Bang For Your Buck arcade cabinet are both listed options; story downtime can temporarily block home play, but it returns later.

citations.supports: Four qualifying games and the all-levels completion condition.
The four-game launch list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and wait for Andy's call; her text then marks the strand at her home in Belville. Complete its five listed jobs through Puff Puff Pass. The trophy guide says this optional strand remains available after the campaign.

citations.supports: Lucia-only strand, Chapter 3 call/text, Belville marker and five-mission finish.
Reported post-story availability of side-story finales.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, look for Kenton's green KR marker in Key Lento. Jason follows the strand by diving at its purple shipwreck markers and bringing treasure back; complete all seven wrecks and continue to Kenton's finale. The guide says the strand returns after a Chapter 1 pause and remains available after the story.

citations.supports: Island Dreams timing, Key Lento marker, seven wrecks and character progress paths.
Kenton's side-story mission index.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, find Billy's strand at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete its five jobs, ending with Hometown Heroes. The source says it stays open after the main story, so this can be reserved for free-roam cleanup.

citations.supports: Coffee Break unlock, Mudclub location, five missions and final mission.
Reported post-story availability.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight strands that the game actually classifies as Strangers & Freaks. Many optional questlines do not count, so check the trophy counter after every finale. Yago's street-racing strand includes Race Against Yago, reported as a Chapter 3 hourglass-timed mission; complete it as soon as it appears in case it is one of your counted strands. The cited launch sources do not confirm that this race is required for the trophy.
trophies.confidence: Timing watch: Race Against Yago is reported as time-limited and may count toward the eight-strand total, but the relationship is unconfirmed.

citations.supports: Which side-story strands count and Yago's four-mission sequence.
Yago's named race mission and its position in the strand.
Chapter 3 timing risk and advice to start the race when it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS, follow Randy's Wish List marker in west Vice City. Scan the 16 requested high-end sports cars, deliver each to Randy, and continue until the strand's final mission. The source lists this as available after the campaign too.

citations.supports: Named Chapter 3 unlock, west Vice City marker, 16-car list and continuation.
Side-quest route index.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, switch to Jason and follow the purple Kitty Litter Synthetic Lab markers. Clear enough labs to start Tyrone's second mission, Spin On This, then complete the lab shutdown. The guide says this optional strand remains available after the story.

citations.supports: Here, Kitty Kitty unlock, Jason-only access, Vice City lab markers and finale.
Tyrone's side-story mission index.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Use the purple map markers and meditation progress page to clear every spot. Do Lucia's optional balcony session in Chapter 1 after Down to Earth as a precaution; the sources agree it increments a counter but say its necessity for this trophy is unresolved. Later spots can be cleaned up in free roam.
trophies.confidence: Precaution: cited guides had not confirmed whether the Chapter 1 balcony session is required for the trophy.

citations.supports: Eighteen meditations, map markers and the early balcony session's uncertain trophy role.
The Chapter 1 timing and precaution.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, play as Jason and wait for Bret's text; his first quest, Veteran Hunted, is marked in Lummox County. Complete the target-deck hunts and bring the requested animals back to Bret. The source reports 15 target decks for the larger 100% checklist and says the strand stays open after the story; the exact animal that unlocks this trophy was still awaiting confirmation.
trophies.confidence: The exact animal-trigger requirement was unconfirmed in the cited trophy guide; this route describes how to start the hunting strand, not a guaranteed single-animal trigger.

citations.supports: Jason-only Chapter 2 unlock, Veteran Hunted in Lummox County and 15 target decks.
Bret's questline context and linked animal guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish three full card sets rather than collecting three loose cards. The location guide catalogs the sets; use Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards to see set completion and avoid duplicating a card already in a finished set.

citations.supports: Set locations and collection-tracker path.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app at scannable locations and follow the nearby-location prompt. Check Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations to see the count; this location scan is distinct from discovering vehicles for Whip It Good.

citations.supports: WAiNK location scanning and collection tracker.
The separate 100-location checklist target.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Challenges and finish any 50 entries. The 100% checklist uses a separate target of 70 out of 80, so continuing to 50 earns this trophy while leaving the harder checklist cleanup for later.

citations.supports: Challenge progress menu and the 50-trophy / 70-checklist distinction.
The checklist's 70-of-80 target.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Have your partner with you when the four-star chase begins, then leave the red search/heat area as well as losing the active wanted level. Output Lag reports that the unlock can wait until you are fully clear of the heat; its escape guide has the distinction between wanted stars and the search zone.

citations.supports: Partner condition and reported heat-zone escape timing.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner and rob three different shops in one uninterrupted police chase. Keep the wanted stars active between stops; if they fade, the chain breaks. Wait briefly after the third shop for the trophy notification before continuing.

citations.supports: Partner, continuous wanted-level chain and delayed unlock note.
The named trophy requirement.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel. A scan records a discovery; driving a car is not the same task. The linked guide says vehicle discoveries can be checked in the trophy counter and that this activity overlaps with the 100% vehicle-scanning work.

citations.supports: WAiNK scanning steps and vehicle discovery counter.
Vehicle scanning as part of completion cleanup.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Build the Focus meter, then trigger Combat Focus when several hostile enemies are in view. Use a reliable weapon and aim for five takedowns before that single Focus window ends; the source recommends hostile gang encounters rather than civilians or police.

citations.supports: Combat Focus preparation, enemy count and encounter advice.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Output Lag's launch guide identifies a passenger jet at a boarding bridge as the reported trigger, then says to fly well clear of the airport and allow time for the delayed pop. It gives E3 and E4 as candidate gates; save first because the airport is guarded.

citations.supports: Reported boarding-bridge aircraft, candidate gates and delayed unlock.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The cited trophy guide interprets the clue as taking a military Rhino tank for a drive. It points to Mile Zero Air Station; prepare an escape route and a manual save before entering the guarded base.

citations.supports: Tank interpretation and reported Mile Zero Air Station location.
The trophy-section trigger interpretation.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The cited launch guide says Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs opens this robbery type. Use the Snap Gun on a locked back entrance instead of forcing the door, then loot the store and leave without alerting anyone; reload a manual save if the alarm is raised.

citations.supports: Jewelry-job unlock, Snap Gun entry and undetected approach.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete five large-bank vault robberies and escape each time. The Chapter 4 optional introduction opens vault jobs; the location guide lists all eight, while the 100% checklist asks for all eight, more than this trophy's five.

citations.supports: Vault unlock, robbery flow and eight-vault list.
All-eight checklist requirement.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat area. The cited guide reports that a large-bank vault job also counts for this robbery trophy, so you can combine it with bank cleanup; wait until fully clear before expecting the pop.

citations.supports: Reported vault-job overlap and heat-zone escape condition.
Bank vault sequence and escape context.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the world map and check the exploration-area progress until the regional tracker is complete. The trophy description does not give a number; the cited launch guide reports 52 named areas, so treat that as a source-reported target and verify against the in-game counter.

citations.supports: Reported Leonida area count and map exploration tracker.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Complete at least one Illegal Operation for each of the nine gangs. The location guide maps operations and Progress > Gangs can show which gang still needs a completion; the trophy does not ask for all 39 operations.

citations.supports: Nine-gang coverage, locations and gang progress menu.
One operation per gang versus the larger 100% set.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Use the description as the current lead: have a cocktail at Ocean Beach with a clear view. The launch guide lists this hidden trophy among triggers without a confirmed method, so treat the location wording as a clue rather than a verified step-by-step unlock.
trophies.confidence: Unlock method not confirmed in the cited launch guide; the description is the only reliable lead here.

citations.supports: The hidden trophy's unconfirmed trigger status.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to breaking out through a vehicle showroom rather than a normal vehicle theft. No launch-confirmed trigger is supplied by the cited guide; keep this as an experiment, not a guaranteed method.
trophies.confidence: The cited launch guide reports no confirmed unlock method for this hidden trophy.

citations.supports: The trophy's unconfirmed launch status.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Output Lag identifies Kolt & Associates as Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation in Port Gellhorn. Its reported route is to take the three key valuables during the robbery and escape; the operation can return later if something was missed, so this is not reported as permanently missable.

citations.supports: Kolt & Associates location, three valuables and repeat availability.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break unlocks character switching, train with Jason and Lucia at a fitness club until both reach maximum Strength at the same time. Check each character under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength. Call your partner before the workout; the source reports that the other character trains alongside the one you control, so one session advances both.
trophies.confidence: Reported launch guide trigger; verify the in-game trophy pop before relying on it as a confirmed condition.

citations.supports: Maximum Strength condition, stat menu, Chapter 2 unlock and partner-training method.
The same proposed partner-strength lead.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile to see which actions register. The trophy guide reports a 500-action counter: stealthy objectives and clean robbery escapes affect one profile style, while incapacitating or killing enemies affects others. Check the trophy counter; normal encounters add progress, so a separate grind may be unnecessary.

citations.supports: 500-action count, notification setting and profile-changing action examples.
The report that robberies and encounters advance the profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The launch guide had no confirmed trigger for this hidden trophy. Its phrase suggests a second attempt after a failure, but the exact activity and success condition remain unverified; do not spend time repeating a specific event on that guess alone.
trophies.confidence: No confirmed trigger in the cited launch guide; a second-attempt interpretation is speculation from the description.

citations.supports: Unconfirmed trigger status and description-only lead.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Output Lag reports two unconfirmed launch leads: in Crosstown, a stairwell east of Pawn & Gun may show glowing graffiti with a six-digit code for a ground-floor safe; separately, Lucia's Chapter 2 UFO-abduction side story has a reported Abandoned Site keypad lead northeast of Cottonmouth Lake. The cited article says the code fails for many players. Treat both as sightings to test, not verified triggers.
trophies.confidence: Neither reported lead is confirmed, and the Abandoned Site code is reported to fail for many players.

citations.supports: Both launch leads, the Crosstown landmark and the reported unreliable keypad code.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride a motorcycle and use the melee attack against pedestrians while moving. The cited guide reports a quick test of ten targets within about a minute; because the PS5 description is shorter, watch the in-game trophy counter rather than assuming the suggested timing is official.

citations.supports: Reported motorcycle melee-drive-by approach and target count.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Credit Check unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, collect Marked Bills from robberies and deliver them to a Fence. The total is cumulative according to the cited guide; track deliveries rather than expecting a single $250,000 haul.

citations.supports: Dye Pack Jammer unlock, bill sources, Fence delivery and cumulative total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend money at shops across the world and let the trophy counter add the purchases together. The requirement is cumulative across shop types; avoid spending solely at one kind of business if the counter is not moving.

citations.supports: Cumulative spending across shop types.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the eight purchasable garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. The source says the app appears after Daily Driver; story-provided garages do not replace these eight purchases.

citations.supports: Eight purchasable locations.
App unlock timing and story-garage distinction.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 Moses mission installs Scooter Bros, take eligible vehicles to his garage and use Respray > Register. Keep enough parking capacity for registered vehicles; the linked guide notes later Pay 'n' Spray registration as another option for standard trackers.

citations.supports: Scooter Bros unlock, registration steps and parking-capacity constraint.
